title: Tickets
description: Send a request to a department and follow it, or answer the tickets that arrive for you.
searchPlaceholder: Search by title, details or number

empty.mine: You have not sent any ticket yet.
empty.inbox: No tickets have arrived for you.

emptyHint.mine: Press “New ticket” to send your request to the right department.
emptyHint.inbox: Tickets assigned to you appear here, or your department's tickets if you manage it.

new.title: New ticket
new.description: Choose the department and the type, then write your request.

choose.personalNotice: Complaints and personal matters go to Human Resources directly.
choose.nothing: No department receives tickets right now.
choose.paused: This department has paused receiving tickets for now.
choose.notStarted: This department has not started working yet.
choose.noManager: This department has no manager at the moment.

details.title: Title
details.titleRequired: Write a title for the ticket.
details.tooEarly: The earliest date this department accepts is {{date}}.

reply.label: Your reply
reply.closedNote: The ticket is closed and takes no new replies.

events.confirmed: The sender confirmed it was done

actions.reopenLeft_one: You can reopen it within 1 day
actions.reopenLeft_other: You can reopen it within {{count}} days

request-close.title: Request closing
request-close.description: The sender is asked to confirm it was done, and it closes by itself if they do not answer in time.

confirm-close.title: Confirm the request was carried out
confirm-close.description: The ticket closes as soon as you confirm.

decline-close.title: Decline the closing
decline-close.description: The ticket goes back to the department, open, with your message.

reopen.title: Reopen the ticket
reopen.description: The ticket goes back to the department, open.

close-without-execution.title: Close without carrying out
close-without-execution.description: The ticket closes without the request being carried out. Explain why to the sender.

setup.title: Ticket setup
setup.description: Set how your department receives tickets: types and durations.
setup.noManager: This department has no manager yet: assign one in the organization structure to activate it.
setup.needAdminMode: This page works in platform admin mode. Turn it on at the top of the page.
setup.noneHint: The departments you manage appear here.
setup.receptionIntro: Decide whether the department receives tickets now, and what the sender reads.

receptionHint.active: The department is listed and receives tickets.
receptionHint.paused: The department is listed but disabled with a message, and is resumed by hand. Existing tickets are handled as usual.
receptionHint.stopped: The department is not listed for anyone. Existing tickets are handled as usual.

setup.needsManager: A department without a manager cannot be activated.
setup.acceptsPersonal: Accepts personal requests (the unit manager does not see them)
setup.descriptionHint: Shown to the employee when they choose this department.

days.minLeadDays: Earliest date that can be asked for
days.autoCloseDays: Automatic closing after a closing request

setup.workingDays: In working days (Friday and Saturday are off)
setup.typesIntro: Each type has a name, a description, an assignee and an optional own duration.
setup.noTypes: No types yet. Add one so the department can receive tickets.

type.assigneeHint: The employee tickets are assigned to. Required for a personal type.
type.personalNeedsAssignee: A personal type needs an assignee.
type.dueDaysHint: Leave empty to use the department's duration.
type.personal: Personal type: the unit manager does not see it, only the sender and the assignee
type.description: The type's name and description are shown to the employee when they send.
type.noAssignee: No assignee: the department manager handles them
type.deactivated: The type was deactivated because it has tickets.
type.removeBody: The type is deleted if it has no tickets; otherwise it is deactivated and its tickets stay.

setup.durationsIntro: Set the durations in days: usual completion time, minimum lead, auto-close, reopen window and stale tickets.

figures.title: Ticket performance
figures.none: No department is set up yet
figures.noneHint: Set up a department on the “Ticket setup” page and its figures appear here.
